sn35.88:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Puṇṇo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā || pe || || 3 Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Puṇṇo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.88:1.2: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham Bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || || 4
sn35.88:2.1: Santi kho Puṇṇā cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.88:2.2: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.88:2.3: tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi ||
sn35.88:2.5: Santi kho Puṇṇa sotaviññeyyā saddā || || Ghānaviññeyyā gandhā || || Jivhāviññeyyā rasā || || Kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā || ||
sn35.88:2.6: Santi kho Puṇṇa manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.88:2.7: tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.88:2.8: tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi ||
sn35.88:3.1: Santi ca kho Puṇṇa cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmūpasaṃhita rajanīyā ||
sn35.88:3.2: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa tam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nirujjhati nandi ||
sn35.88:3.4: Santi kho Puṇṇa manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn35.88:3.5: tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa tam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nirujjhati nandi ||
sn35.88:4.1: Iminā tvam Puṇṇa mayā saṅkhittena ovādena ovādito katamasmiṃ janapade viharissasīti || ||
sn35.88:4.2: Atthi bhante Sunāparanto nāma janapado tatthāham viharissāmīti || || 7
sn35.88:5.3: sace tvam Puṇṇa Sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti tatra te Puṇṇa kinti bhavissatī ti || ||
sn35.88:6.1: Sace mam bhante Sunāparantakā manussā akkosissanti paribhāsissanti tatra me evam bhavissati ||
sn35.88:6.2: Bhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā || yam maṃ nayime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentīti ||
sn35.88:7.1: Sace pana te Puṇṇa Sunāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāram dassanti tatra pana te Puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti || ||
sn35.88:8.1: Sace mam bhante Sunāparantakā manussā pāṇinā pahāraṃ dassanti tatra me evam bhavissati ||
sn35.88:8.2: Bhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā || yam maṃ na yime leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dentīti ||
sn35.88:9.1: Sace pana te Puṇṇa Sunāparantakā manussā leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti tatra pana te Puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti || ||
sn35.88:10.1: Sace me bhante Sunāparantakā manussā leḍḍunā pahāraṃ dassanti tatra me evam bhavissati ||
sn35.88:10.2: Bhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā || Yam maṃ na yime daṇḍena pahāraṃ dentīti ||
sn35.88:11.1: Sace pana te Puṇṇa Sunāparantakā manussā daṇḍena pahāram dassanti tatra pana te Puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti || ||
sn35.88:12.1: Sace me bhante Sunāparantakā manussā daṇḍena pahāram dassanti tatra me evam bhavissati ||
sn35.88:12.2: Bhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā || yam maṃ na yime satthena pahāraṃ dentīti
sn35.88:13.1: Sace pana te Puṇṇa Sunāparantakā satthena pahāraṃ dassanti tatra pana te Puṇṇa Kinti bhavissatīti || ||
sn35.88:14.1: Sace me bhante Sunāparantakāmanussāsatthena pahāraṃ dassanti tatra me evam bhavissati ||
sn35.88:14.2: Bhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā subhaddakā vatime Sunāparantakā manussā || yam maṃ na yime tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropentīti
sn35.88:15.1: Sace pana tvam Puṇṇa Sunāparantakā manussā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropessanti tatra pana te Puṇṇa kinti bhavissatīti || ||
sn35.88:16.1: Sace mam bhante Sunāparantakā manussā tiṇhena satthena jīvitā voropessanti tatra me evam bhavissati ||
sn35.88:16.2: Santi kho tassa Bhagavato sāvakā kāyena ca jīvitena ca aṭṭhiyamānā harāyamānā jigucchamānā satthahārakam pariyesanti || tam me idaṃ apariyiṭṭhaññeva satthahārakam laddhanti
sn35.88:17.2: sakkhasi kho tvam iminā damūpasamena samannāgato Sunāparantakasmiṃ janapade vatthuṃ ||
sn35.88:18.1: Atha kho āyasmā Puṇṇo Bhagavato vacanam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā senāsanaṃ saṃsāmetvā pattacīvaram ādāya yena Sunāparanto janapado || tena cārikam pakkāmi || ||
sn35.88:18.2: Anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena Sunāparanto janapado tad avasari ||
sn35.88:18.3: tatra sudam āyasmā Puṇṇo Sunāparantasmiṃ janapade viharati || || 15
sn35.88:18.4: Atha kho āyasmā Puṇṇo teneva antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭipādesi ||
sn35.88:19.1: Atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu || pe || || 17 Ekam antaṃ nisinnā kho te bhikkhū Bhagavantam etad avocuṃ || ||
sn35.88:19.2: Yo so bhante Puṇṇo nāma kulaputto Bhagavatā saṃkhittena ovādena ovādito so kālaṃ kato ||
sn35.88:19.3: tassa kā gati ko abhisamparāyo ti || ||
sn35.88:20.1: Paṇḍito bhikkhave Puṇṇo kulaputto ahosi || paccapādi dhammassa cānudhammam na ca maṃ dhammādhikaraṇaṃ vihesesi || ||
